source_text: Εἰ γάρ πού τινες καὶ τῷ σώματι τὴν ἁμαρτίαν διέφυγον, ἀλλὰ πάντως γε ταῖς ψυχαῖς τὴν φθορὰν ὑπεδέξαντο. Ταῦτά μοι καὶ περὶ τῶν ἀῤῥένων εἰρήσθω. Εἶδε κακῶς, ἐθεάθη κακῶς. Ὁ ἐμβλέψας γυναικὶ πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν. Εἰ αἱ ἀπὸ ταυτομάτου συντυχίαι τοῖς περιέργως κατασκοποῦσι τοσοῦτον ἔχουσι κίνδυνον, αἱ κατ' ἐπιτήδευσιν ἀπαντήσεις, ὥστε ἰδεῖν γυναῖκας ἀσχημονούσας ὑπὸ τῆς μέθης, καὶ κατασχηματιζομένας πρὸς ἔκλυσιν, καὶ μέλη τεθρυμμένα ἀδούσας, δυνάμενα καὶ μόνον ἀκουσθέντα πάντα οἶστρον ἡδονῆς ἐμποιῆσαι τοῖς ἀκολάστοις, τί ἐροῦσιν, ἢ τί ἀπολογήσονται, ἐκ τοιούτων θεαμάτων μυρίων ἐσμὸν τῶν κακῶν συλλεξάμενοι; Οὐχ, ὡς διὰ τοῦτο ἐμβλέψαντες, ἵνα τὰς ἐπιθυμίας ἐγείρωσιν; Οὐκοῦν ὑπόδικοί εἰσι, κατὰ τὴν ἀπαραίτητον ἀπόφασιν τοῦ Κυρίου, τῷ κρίματι τῆς μοιχείας. Πῶς ὑμᾶς ἡ Πεντηκοστὴ ὑποδέξεται, οὕτω τοῦ Πάσχα καθυβρισθέντος; Ἡ Πεντηκοστὴ τοῦ Πνεύματος ἔσχε τοῦ ἁγίου τὴν ἐναργῆ καὶ πᾶσι γνωρίμην ἐπιδημίαν· σὺ δὲ, προλαβὼν, σεαυτὸν οἰκητήριον τοῦ ἀντικειμένου ἐποίησας πνεύματος, καὶ ἐγένου ναὸς εἰδώλων, ἀντὶ τοῦ γενέσθαι ναὸς Θεοῦ διὰ τῆς ἐνοικήσεως τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου. Ἐπεσπάσω τὴν ἀρὰν τοῦ προφήτου εἰπόντος ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅτι Στρέψω τὰς ἑορτὰς αὐτῶν εἰς πένθος. Πῶς τῶν οἰκετῶν ἄρξετε, αὐτοὶ δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις ἀνοήτοις καὶ βλαβεραῖς ὡς ἀνδράποδα; Πῶς τοὺς παῖδας νουθετήσετε, ἀνουθέτητον ζωὴν καὶ ἀδιάτακτον ζῶντες; Τί οὖν; Ἐν τούτοις ὑμᾶς καταλείπω; Ἀλλὰ φοβοῦμαι, μή πως ὁ μὲν ἀνυπότακτος στραγότερος γένηται, ὁ κατανενυγμένος τῇ περισσοτέρᾳ λύπῃ καταποθῇ. Ἴαμα γὰρ, φησὶ, καταπαύσει ἁμαρτίας μεγάλας. Ἡ νηστεία τὴν μέθην θεραπευσάτω· ψαλμὸς τὴν αἰσχρὰν μελῳδίαν· δάκρυον γενέσθω τοῦ γέλωτος ἴαμα· ἀντὶ τῆς ὀρχήσεως τὸ γόνυ κλινέσθω· ἀντὶ τοῦ κρότου τῶν χειρῶν τὸ στῆθος τυπτέσθω· ἀντὶ τοῦ κόσμου τῆς ἐσθῆτος ἡ ταπείνωσις. Ἐπὶ πᾶσιν ἡ ἐλεημοσύνη ἐξαγοραζέτω σε ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας. Λύτρον γὰρ ἀνδρὸς ὁ ἴδιος αὐτοῦ πλοῦτος. Πολλοὺς ἐργάτευσον τῶν θλιβομένων εἰς τὴν κοινωνίαν τῆς προσευχῆς, εἰ ἄρα σοι ἀφεθήσεται ἡ ἐπίνοια τῆς κακίας. Ὅτε ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν· (ἡ δὲ παιδιὰ αὐτῶν εἰδωλολατρεία ἦν·) τότε οἱ Λευῗται, κατὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἑαυτοὺς ἐξοπλίσαντες, εἰς ἱερωσύνην τὰς χεῖρας ἑαυτῶν ἐτελείωσαν. Καὶ ὑμῖν τοίνυν τοῖς φοβουμένοις τὸν Κύριον, ὅσοι νῦν ἐπεστυγνάσατε ἐπὶ τῇ ἀσχημοσύνῃ τῶν καταγνωσθέντων, ἐκεῖνο διαστελλόμεθα· Ἐὰν μὲν ἴδητε μετανοοῦντας ἐπὶ τῇ ἀτοπίᾳ τῶν πεπραγμένων, συμπαθήσατε ὡς οἰκείοις μέλεσι νενοσηκόσιν· ἐὰν δὲ ἀπαυθαδιαζομένους καὶ καταφρονοῦντας τῆς ὑμετέρας ἐπ' αὐτοῖς λύπης, Ἐξέλθετε ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀφορίσθητε, καὶ ἀκαθάρτου μὴ ἅπτεσθε· ἵνα οὕτως οἱ μὲν ἐντραπέντες εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἔλθωσι τῆς οἰκείας κακίας· ὑμεῖς δὲ τοῦ ζήλου τοῦ Φινεὲς τὸν μισθὸν ὑποδέξησθε, διὰ τῆς δικαιοκρισίας τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
thought_title: The remedy for drunkenness and the call to separate
orientation: Basil is closing his homily, first stating the guilt of those who watched the drunken spectacles, then prescribing repentance and separation from the unrepentant.
pass_a_gloss: For if some anywhere also escaped the sin in the body, yet certainly in their souls they received the corruption. Let this also have been said by me about the males. He saw badly, he was seen badly. The one who looked at a woman in order to desire already committed adultery. If the chance encounters have so much danger for those who watch curiously, the meetings by design, so as to see women behaving shamefully under drunkenness, and putting on forms for laxity, and singing broken songs, which are able even only when heard to produce all the sting of pleasure in the lustful, what will they say, or what will they say in defense, having gathered from such spectacles a countless swarm of evils? Did they not, as for this reason, look, in order that they might rouse their desires? Therefore they are liable, according to the unalterable sentence of the Lord, to the judgment of adultery. How will Pentecost receive you, when Pascha has been so insulted? Pentecost had the clear and to all known visitation of the Holy Spirit; but you, having anticipated, made yourself a dwelling of the opposing spirit, and you became a temple of idols, instead of becoming a temple of God through the indwelling of the Holy Spirit. You drew upon yourself the curse of the prophet who said from the person of God, that I will turn their feasts into mourning. How will you rule your household slaves, yourselves serving as slaves to foolish and harmful desires like captives? How will you admonish your children, living an unadmonished and disordered life? What then? Do I leave you in these things? But I fear, lest somehow the unsubmissive one become more estranged, and the one pierced be swallowed up by the more abundant grief. For healing, he says, will put an end to great sins. Let fasting heal drunkenness; let a psalm heal the shameful song; let tears become the healing of laughter; instead of the dance let the knee be bent; instead of the clapping of hands let the breast be struck; instead of the adornment of clothing let there be humility. Above all let almsgiving ransom you from sin. For a man's ransom is his own wealth. Make many of the afflicted workers for the fellowship of prayer, if perhaps the thought of evil may be forgiven you. When the people sat down to eat and drink, and they rose up to play; (and their play was idolatry;) then the Levites, having armed themselves against their brothers, consecrated their hands to the priesthood. And to you therefore who fear the Lord, as many as now were grieved at the shamelessness of those condemned, we give that command: If you see them repenting of the absurdity of what was done, sympathize as with your own members that have been sick; but if they are obstinate and despise your grief over them, Come out from the midst of them, and be separated, and do not touch the unclean thing; so that thus those who are ashamed may come to knowledge of their own evil; and you may receive the reward of the zeal of Phinehas, through the righteous judgment of our God and Savior Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

choices.why: κατασχηματίζω means to put on a form or figure, i.e., making contorted poses; πρὸς ἔκλυσιν indicates the purpose of moral laxity or dissolution, not a goal of 'dissolution' as an end in itself
τεθρυμμένα is the perfect passive participle of θρύπτω, meaning broken or shattered; the songs are morally or structurally broken, not merely lascivious
στραγγός means alien or estranged; the comparative describes the unsubmissive person becoming more alienated, not more stubborn
ἐξαγοράζω means to buy back or ransom; the glossary specifies almsgiving as ransom from sin, so the commercial metaphor is preserved
ἐπίνοια means thought, device, or contrivance; here it refers to the evil intention or scheme, not merely the act
ἀπαυθαδιάζομαι means to be stubborn or obstinate in a self-willed way; the contrast with repentance requires a term for defiant persistence

pass_b_english: For even if some escaped the sin in body, they certainly received the corruption in their souls. Let this be said by me also about the men. He saw wrongly, and he was seen wrongly. Whoever looks at a woman to desire her has already committed adultery (Matthew 5:28). If chance encounters hold so much danger for those who watch with curiosity, what will they say, or how will they defend themselves, when they have gathered a swarm of countless evils from such spectacles—meetings arranged on purpose, so as to see women disgracing themselves under drunkenness, putting on forms for laxity, and singing with wanton, effeminate melodies, which even merely heard can stir every frenzy of pleasure in the lustful? Did they not look for this very reason, to rouse their desires? Therefore they are liable, according to the unalterable sentence of the Lord, to the judgment of adultery. How will Pentecost receive you, when Pascha has been so insulted? Pentecost had the clear and universally known visitation of the Holy Spirit; but you, getting ahead of it, made yourself a dwelling place of the opposing spirit, and you became a temple of idols instead of becoming a temple of God through the indwelling of the Holy Spirit. You drew upon yourself the curse of the prophet who said from the person of God: I will turn their feasts into mourning (Amos 8:10). How will you rule your household slaves, when you yourselves serve foolish and harmful desires like slaves? How will you admonish your children, when you live an unadmonished and disordered life? What then? Do I leave you in these things? But I am afraid that the unsubmissive one may become more headstrong, and the one who is pierced may be swallowed up by excessive grief. For healing, it says, will put an end to great sins (Ecclesiasticus 28:2). Let fasting heal drunkenness; let a psalm heal the shameful song; let tears become the healing of laughter; instead of dancing, let the knee be bent; instead of the clapping of hands, let the breast be struck; instead of the adornment of clothing, let there be humility. Above all, let almsgiving ransom you from sin. For a man's own wealth is his ransom (Proverbs 13:8). Enlist many of the afflicted as workers in the fellowship of prayer, if perhaps the thought of evil may be forgiven you. When the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play—and their play was idolatry—then the Levites, arming themselves against their brothers, consecrated their hands for the priesthood (Exodus 32:6). And so to you who fear the Lord, as many as have now been grieved at the shamelessness of those who are condemned, we give this command: if you see them repenting of the absurdity of what they have done, sympathize with them as with your own sick members; but if they are obstinate and despise your grief over them, come out from among them, and be separate, and touch no unclean thing (2 Corinthians 6:17), so that those who are put to shame may come to knowledge of their own evil, and you may receive the reward of Phinehas's zeal, through the righteous judgment of our God and Savior Jesus Christ, to whom be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.

problems.why: οἶστρος is frenzy/madness of lust, not mild 'sting'; force weakened.

problems.quote: Make many of the afflicted your fellow workers in prayer
problems.source_quote: Πολλοὺς ἐργάτευσον τῶν θλιβομένων εἰς τὴν κοινωνίαν τῆς προσευχῆς
problems.why: ἐργάτευσον means 'make them work' (put them to work), not 'make them fellow workers'.
problems.fix: Press many of the afflicted into the work of shared prayer
problems.ruling: ἐργάτευσον means 'set to work'; 'fellow workers' (συνεργούς) changes meaning: employ afflicted in prayer, not make them partners.

problems.why: μέλη here = 'limbs' (body parts), not 'songs'; ἀδούσας = 'unwashed/undanced', not 'singing'. The phrase means 'limbs trained by dancing'.
problems.ruling: μέλη = 'limbs' (not 'songs'); ἀδούσας from ἀδέω = 'unbound/loose' (not 'singing'). 'τεθρυμμένα' = 'weakened/dissolved'. Phrase describes loose, dissolving limbs from drunkenness, not songs.
